title: Gen-T
summary: Gen-T is an academic research system that compresses distributed-tracing data in microservice architectures using deep generative models, exposed through a GenTDriver train/generate API. It bundles and modifies the CTGAN library (which itself uses rdt's transformers for data normalization) in libs/CTGAN as its core generative compression engine.
evidence: README: 'Install our modified version of CTGAN'; libs/CTGAN/ctgan/data_transformer.py imports rdt.transformers.ClusterBasedNormalizer, OneHotEncoder
needs: Could not confirm from evidence whether GenTDriver.train()/generate() directly calls the vendored CTGAN classes, though the vendored package is clearly modified and packaged as a dependency.
